news.title: At Montpellier's MoCo museum, Kiki Smith explores our animal nature

summary: Moco Museum is museum for modern and contemporary art in Amsterdam, Barcelona and London, founded in 2016. Type: startup / scale-up. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

culture.text: Shows modern classics by artists like Basquiat, Warhol, Kusama, KAWS and Keith Haring, plus new immersive works by contemporary stars.
Has locations on Amsterdam's Museumplein, in Barcelona's Gothic Quarter and near Marble Arch in London.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Expanded from Amsterdam to Barcelona and now London.
